{{Top|leg}}
A '''flotation cell''' was a type of flotation device fitted in a [[signblimp]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a group pursuing the the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] fired on a signblimp, causing some of its flotation cells to puncture. Shortly thereafter, Zuma, Irana and Be'ray hijacked another signblimp which crashed into a bridge, bursting most of its flotation cells.<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
